recall.minute: Seq2seq: encoder → context vector → decoder; word-for-word fails (Je t'aime); a fixed vector (e.g. 256 numbers) is a bottleneck. RNN hₜ = tanh(W_h hₜ₋₁ + W_x xₜ + b): 'I don't like NLP' with W_h = 0.5I, W_x = I gives h₁ = [0.762, 0], h₂ = [0.363, −0.762], h₃ = [0.828, 0.551], h₄ = [−0.527, 0.855]. Gradients multiply per step and vanish (telephone game; cats … are); LSTMs use forget/input/output gates and Cₜ = fC + iC̃. Attention: s = [1, 0], bank [1, 1], river [0, 1] → e = 1, 0 → α = 0.73, 0.27 → c = [0.73, 1.00]; soft alignment (poste = mail/job). Transformer (2017): self-attention softmax(QKᵀ/√dₖ)V, parallel; multi-head = Concat(heads)W^O ('it' → animal/street); FFN 512 → 2048 → 512; padding and look-ahead masks; LayerNorm(x + Sublayer(x)); sinusoidal PE (clock hands). BERT: encoder stack, contextual embeddings (river vs money bank), MLM 15% (80/10/10), NSP (store/milk true, penguins false), fine-tuned with small heads.
